title: PCS: Perceived Confidence Scoring of Black Box LLMs with Metamorphic Relations
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical methodology (Perceived Confidence Score) to measure uncertainty and confidence in black-box LLM predictions using Metamorphic Relations. While it mentions ethics and bias in the introduction as motivation for creating reliable models, it does not evaluate or benchmark moral reasoning, ethical frameworks, or religious values as part of its core study.
